data.hypothesis: Adapting T1's unsigned accumulation to T2's measured CUB BlockReduce structure should preserve the exact int32 result bits even when intermediate sums overflow signed int, while retaining T2's efficient single-CTA small-input path and two-kernel large-input path. The arithmetic adaptation's performance is unmeasured.

memory_lessons.applicability: CUDA int32 reductions where the true result fits int32 but intermediate partial sums may exceed signed range.
memory_lessons.claim: T2's CUB BlockReduce candidate measured 6.458 µs and was correct on supplied cases; T1's hand-written unsigned reduction measured 6.831 µs. Unsigned modulo accumulation can be adapted independently of T1's slower reduction structure.
memory_lessons.next_experiment: Validate cancellation/extreme partial-sum cases and measure the unsigned-arithmetic adaptation, then independently confirm the selected final candidate.

data.notes: Retained T2's measured CUB BlockReduce geometry and direct output path; adapted only unsigned modulo accumulation from T1. T1's measured tile/reduction implementation was not transplanted, and T3's large-input fallback was not retained. The adapted candidate itself has not yet been measured or independently confirmed.
transformations: Retained T2's 256-thread CUB BlockReduce, eight elements per thread, and 2048-element tiles.
Changed thread, tile, partial, and final accumulators to unsigned int; convert each signed input to unsigned before addition to obtain defined modulo-2^32 sums.
Preserved the one-CTA path for inputs fitting one tile and the two-kernel path for larger inputs, with the final kernel writing output directly.

model_reported.name: integrer-optimisations
model_reported.summary: Used T2 as the measured base and adapted T1's unsigned accumulation concept without transplanting T1's slower reduction structure.

model_reported.name: inspecter-environnement
model_reported.summary: Kept the supplied frozen NVIDIA GH200 and CUDA 12.6.3 target; no additional environment inspection or target changes were needed.

model_reported.name: consulter-documentation-technique
model_reported.summary: The code retains the already-measured CUB BlockReduce API and changes only integer accumulation types; no unresolved API or hardware property requires documentation.

model_reported.name: evaluer-performances
model_reported.summary: Compared valid research measurements only: T2 was 6.458 µs, T1 6.831 µs, and baseline 46.48 µs. The proposed unsigned adaptation has no measurement yet and needs controller validation and confirmation.
